summary: Off-registry HTTP dependency fetched and executed at install time
details: @flexmr/utils@3.0.12 ships a one-line re-export stub whose package.json declares its sole dependency `daemon-thread-lookup-buffer` via a direct HTTPS URL to a non-registry host: `https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/daemon-thread-lookup-buffer`. The dependency is unpinned, carries no integrity hash, and is not resolved through the npm registry. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that host returns and installs them as a package, executing any lifecycle scripts (`preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`) contained in that artifact; the shipped index.js then re-exports the fetched module so `require('@flexmr/utils')` also loads its code. The manifest further exhibits dependency-confusion shape: the `@flexmr/*` scope with placeholder metadata (author `Package Registry`, generic description, example.com repository) suggests a package intended to shadow an internal name during resolution. Control of install-time and import-time code execution on the installer's host rests entirely with the operator of `artifacts.creditslib.com`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
